description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that gives Express‑level simplicity with Fastify‑grade performance—perfect for edge, serverless, and AI‑powered APIs.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 surge in edge‑first, AI‑ready back‑ends by marketing Yantravese as a zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first framework that ships with built‑in observable reactivity, LLM‑friendly request pipelines, and native Cloudflare/Edge‑Runtime compatibility—delivering Express‑like ergonomics with Fastify‑class speed while staying ESM‑only and ultra‑lightweight.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it eliminates runtime bloat and lets you ship a single file to any edge or serverless platform.
Benchmarks show sub‑1 ms routing latency and 2× higher throughput than Fastify in typical LLM‑gateway workloads.
Rich TypeScript typings, built‑in observable reactivity, and an Express‑style API let you prototype instantly and scale without refactoring.
